additional_info.subject: ID0416463-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/09] Charging issue CRM:00315002506
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Mr. Laurent raised this ticket due to some failed sessions. I checked the logs and I see an error in the LEM meter:
The manufacturer mentions to check the following:
“Check cabling issues, loosened bolts, over-confined architecture, insufficient ventilation...”
The last two don't really seem like an option to me since this would mean a lot of chargers would have this issue but in any case we could check if the filters are dirty.
I checked for the last 7 days and this issue only started occuring on the 31st March.
I recommend you to bring a spare LEM to site in case we are not able to find the root cause, and replace it.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0416463 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)

Thank you.
